purpose: Phase 2 of ds-tune: tune `publishes[]` arrays across leaderboards in data/sources-whitelist.json so every (modelId, benchKey) pair has at least one fetchable advertised source. Higher predicted_reach = more routing options for the orchestrator's deep-fetch loop = more coverage in real refresh-all cycles. Slug correctness (hit_rate_at_1) is the secondary guard so coverage experiments don't accidentally regress slug ordering.
